title: Gemini Craft
description: An AI integration plugin powered by Gemini for personal assistance in your blocky adventure!
body:
## **Gemini AI integration for block game.**

## Dependences:
- Java 17+
- Paper/Spigot/anything can run plugin with 1.18+ (older support on near future)

## Usage:
- /gemini (Display plugin info)
- /gemini ask <prompt> (Send prompt to gemini)
- /gemini toggle (toggling to chat directly into Gemini)
- /gemini enable (Enable this plugin)
- /gemini disable (Disable this plugin)
- /gemini help (Show usage on this plugin)

## In use images:
![Inuse image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/497736bda46b5913ed7a89c8ae1dbecf0ff147a7.png)

## Configuration needed on first run.

You will need to import your GeminiAPI key in config.yml file in order for the plugin to run.
Get one for free here: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey
